description: List addresses the account will not send to. Hard bounces and spam complaints are suppressed automatically. Use this to explain why an email came back with status "suppressed" or an ALL_SUPPRESSED error.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous next_cursor.

email.description: Match addresses containing this substring. Pass a domain ("@acme.com") to see every suppressed address there.

reason.description: Filter by why the address was suppressed.

name: list_suppressions

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page.

title: List suppressed addresses
